name: Gaussian Rasterization with F-Count
definition: A variant of 3D Gaussian rasterization that computes an additional output: the number of times each Gaussian is activated (rendered) during the forward pass, alongside the standard color and radii outputs.
summary: Gaussian Rasterization with F-Count is a 3D Gaussian Splatting variant that outputs per-Gaussian activation counts alongside standard colors, enabling importance scoring and pruning for optimization.
